contexts.quote: This addendum updates the earlier motivation and missing-input account; it does not replace the supported identities above. Ledger entries 37-41 and 49-58 carry the reviewed account. Q reports correct mutation ordering and systematic absolute offsets (inputs/Q.txt:849-871), with no numerically established I37E-specific residual in the available text. An exactly common offset cancels from the mutation difference. First establish whether a resolved mutation-specific discrepancy exists before treating an electronic correction as predictive repair. A sensitivity study of a defined potential remains a different possible objective.
contexts.where: Under matched endpoint and assay definitions, the corrected mutation residual is \(\Delta_{\mathrm{res}}+C\), with \(\Delta_{\mathrm{res}}\) now denoting the residual rather than the gas constant.
